requests.description:
Creates a budget and, if included, notifications and subscribers.

Only one of BudgetLimit or PlannedBudgetLimits can be present in the syntax at one time. Use the syntax that matches your case. The Request Syntax section shows the BudgetLimit syntax. For PlannedBudgetLimits, see the Examples section.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.CreateBudget

requests.description: Creates a budget action.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.CreateBudgetAction

requests.description: Creates a notification. You must create the budget before you create the associated notification.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.CreateNotification

requests.description: Creates a subscriber. You must create the associated budget and notification before you create the subscriber.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.CreateSubscriber

requests.description:
Deletes a budget. You can delete your budget at any time.

Deleting a budget also deletes the notifications and subscribers that are associated with that budget.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DeleteBudget

requests.description: Deletes a budget action.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DeleteBudgetAction

requests.description:
Deletes a notification.

Deleting a notification also deletes the subscribers that are associated with the notification.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DeleteNotification

requests.description:
Deletes a subscriber.

Deleting the last subscriber to a notification also deletes the notification.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DeleteSubscriber

requests.description:
Describes a budget.

The Request Syntax section shows the BudgetLimit syntax. For PlannedBudgetLimits, see the Examples section.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeBudget

requests.description: Describes a budget action detail.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeBudgetAction

requests.description: Describes a budget action history detail.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeBudgetActionHistories

requests.description: Describes all of the budget actions for an account.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeBudgetActionsForAccount

requests.description: Describes all of the budget actions for a budget.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeBudgetActionsForBudget

requests.description: Lists the budget names and notifications that are associated with an account.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeBudgetNotificationsForAccount

requests.description: Describes the history for DAILY, MONTHLY, and QUARTERLY budgets. Budget history isn't available for ANNUAL budgets.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeBudgetPerformanceHistory

requests.description:
Lists the budgets that are associated with an account.

The Request Syntax section shows the BudgetLimit syntax. For PlannedBudgetLimits, see the Examples section.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeBudgets

requests.description: Lists the notifications that are associated with a budget.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeNotificationsForBudget

requests.description: Lists the subscribers that are associated with a notification.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.DescribeSubscribersForNotification

requests.description: Executes a budget action.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.ExecuteBudgetAction

requests.description:
Updates a budget. You can change every part of a budget except for the budgetName and the calculatedSpend. When you modify a budget, the calculatedSpend drops to zero until Amazon Web Services has new usage data to use for forecasting.

Only one of BudgetLimit or PlannedBudgetLimits can be present in the syntax at one time. Use the syntax that matches your case. The Request Syntax section shows the BudgetLimit syntax. For PlannedBudgetLimits, see the Examples section.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.UpdateBudget

requests.description: Updates a budget action.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.UpdateBudgetAction

requests.description: Updates a notification.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.UpdateNotification

requests.description: Updates a subscriber.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AWSBudgetServiceGateway.UpdateSubscriber
